The '''Salmon''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the river (in [[Pelican Town]] or [[Cindersap Forest]]) during [[Fall]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It may also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Fall, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|75}}.

It can be caught in the waterfalls in southern [[Cindersap Forest]] during Fall at any time.<ref name="waterfall"/>

Salmon can be caught regardless of time of day or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Tailoring==
Salmon is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Faded Denim Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt279.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Salmon can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is light red Salmon [[Roe]].

==Quests==
*'''Item Delivery:''' One Salmon may be randomly requested in [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|225}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Fishing:''' [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] may randomly request 1-4 Salmon to be caught during [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|75}} per fish.  (You get to keep the fish).
*'''Aquatic Overpopulation:''' [[Demetrius]] may request 10 Salmon to be caught in [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] outside the [[Mayor's Manor]] for a reward of gold equivalent to selling the fish and the [[Farm Computer]] recipe.
